key_impacts: More than 100 houses damaged in Fenadesal Sur
About 300 people evacuated to safety from at-risk homes
Nationwide toll from the November 2009 floods reached 198 deaths
evidence_snippets: In November 2009 a torrential rainstorm hit central El Salvador; 198 people were killed.
November’s storm struck Fenadesal Sur, dumping 14 inches of rain in four hours.
Losses: 30 houses destroyed, more than 100 damaged; 300 people made it to safety.
